title: LR1110 radio model validation
description: Validate LR1110 radio model on T1000-E. Driver and hardware validation needed. Test interoperability with SX126X nodes.
notes: Hardware validation required: The LR1110 driver (lichen/drivers/lora/lr1110/lr1110.c, 764 lines) is fully implemented with TX/RX, T1000-E RF switch config, TCXO/calibration, and diagnostic stats. Physical bench testing needed: (1) T1000-E device with LR1110, (2) SX126X nodes (RAK4631/T-Echo) for interoperability testing. Cannot be completed through code changes alone.
